description: Geodetic Marks is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Google KMZ file of SSM and Bencharks with associated metadata. This file can be downloaded directly but is primarily used as a network link for a KML file available from the Landgate website. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are Geodesy. It offers 1 resource(s) in kmz. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
